==Description==
The '''Cold Mist''' was a hidden and ghost enemy that first appeared in the second phase of [[Krampus Frosthold]] as part of the [[Krampus' Revenge Event]]. It had a medium amount of health for its debut and an above average speed. However, as the '''Cold Mist''' was a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemy, only a limited amount of towers can target it and units cannot collide with it. This allowed it to easily overwhelm unprepared defenses.

==Appearance==
The '''Cold Mist''' was a translucent humanoid figure that glowed blue. It floated above the ground, having a wispy tail instead of legs, with its head pointing down toward the ground. It wore a translucent dark blue chain with a lock.  

==Strategy==
*The '''Cold Mist''' can be dangerous because it is a hidden enemy with high health. 
**Towers with high damage and hidden detection capabilities, like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] can be useful against this enemy.
*Area of effect towers with hidden detection, like the [[Golden Pyromancer]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Executioner]] can be useful at clearing out hordes of '''Cold Mists'''.
**Similar towers without hidden detection, like the [[Pursuit]] or [[Mortar]], despite being unable to target the '''Cold Mist''', can still deal damage to it if they are indirectly caught in its explosion.
*Towers placed at the back might have an easier time dealing with the '''Cold Mist''', as it will be separated away from other high health enemies.
*As this enemy is a ghost enemy, units cannot collide with.
**They can, however, still damage it if the unit has hidden detection or if their attacks can indirectly hit.

==Trivia==
*The '''Cold Mist''' borrows the model of the [[Ghost (Lunar Overture)|Ghost]], an enemy from the [[Lunar Overture Event]].
**The lock and chain the '''Cold Mist''' wears is also reminiscent of the [[Wraith]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]].
*On the 24th of December 2023, it was stated officially that the '''Cold Mist's''' health was lowered, despite no actual change occurring.
